method.boundary: Reflect the rectangular first-span reference along the member station axis only. Retain the section, reinforcement, links and symmetric supports. Qualify one outer-bottom cutoff in the second clear span.
method.statics: Recompute signed U1 and U2 rows from three-moment statics and cross-check moment equality and shear reversal at each mirrored station. Exchange the left and right limits at the internal support.
method.development: Follow the cut bar in decreasing x from the theoretical station to its actual left end. Check the reduced cage from the theoretical station toward decreasing x, including the affected left support face. Keep the published section, spacing and cut-length checks.
method.outputs: Verify the actual start and continuing extent of the cut bar in the report and elevation and from the same resolved bar path in the BBS. Non-PASS cases retain a diagnostic report and withhold the checked drawing and BBS.
